## TASK-014 - Adopt the exact root capability and refresh affected guard bindings

Prepare and apply the separately selected source-to-active-root package manifest for only the new ontology integration support and affected current owner contracts. Preserve root-specific Task helper/intake rules and installed initializer v9 unless its exact refresh is independently selected. Use supported guard repair/recertification for changed guarded adapters before new dispatch. Compare required root CURATOR.md, governance, curator.yaml and session wiring against installed owner routes; include only demonstrated integration corrections in the reviewed root-local manifest. Do not create project.json or treat the root as a generic child. Configuration selection and graph publication belong to TASK-015; this task adopts their validated helper/resource support only. Guard repair is conditional on actually changed guarded context and retains the completed 128 MiB bound.
